notes.title: Save System (Beta Version)
notes.content:
[p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45595451/d71f77c37b3e0934130189ce04738c5444fdb7e5.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]In the latest patch (0.6.4) I added the first version of the save system (Steam cloud compatible). This save system is mainly added to debug issues that happen during a run. [/p][p][/p][p]Some players had a crash during a run, with no way to share any data or restart the run. I am hoping that the save system will allow players to restart the run in the case of an unexpected bug. I also think it'll be easier for me to help anyone by simply receiving the save file on Discord. [/p][p][/p][p]This is the first version of the save system so there might be some bugs out there. Let me know if you encounter any issues. [/p][p][/p][p]Thanks,
NourSaiFR

PS: It's worth noting that the demo save file will not be compatible with the full game. This is because I might still make some changes to it before the full release. [/p]

notes.title: Solo Chess (Pokerii)'s Demo Is Out!
notes.content:
[p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45595451/6cc755e62da61a2d62139dee8ea6cc0ba736b781.png"][/img][/p][p]Solo Chess (formerly "Pokerii")'s first public demo (0.6.0) is finally here! [/p][p][/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3909900/Solo_Chess_Demo/"][/dynamiclink][/p][p]Here is what the game has so far.[/p][h2]
Content: [/h2][list][*][p]10 Difficulties.[/p][/*][*][p]6 Decks. [/p][/*][*][p]11 Bosses. [/p][/*][*][p]50 Pet cards. [/p][/*][*][p]7 Mystery gifts. [/p][/*][*][p]7 Dessert cards. [/p][/*][*][p]5 Drink cards. [/p][/*][*][p]2 Status effects (Debuff, Immune). [/p][/*][*][p]3 Auras (Polychrome, Negative, Foil). [/p][/*][*][p]4 Charms (Blue, Purple, Red, Yellow). [/p][/*][*][p]1 Binding (Infinite).[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h2]Non-Game Specific: [/h2][list][*][p]There is no save system (might have a test version before the full release).[/p][/*][*][p]There is only mouse input (no controller for now). [/p][/*][*][p]There are 12 languages implemented.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p]Nothing is locked for now since I am looking for feedback. It's also worth noting that you have to re-start the game whenever you want to start a new run (will be fixed in future patches).

Thanks,
NourSaiFR[/p]
